map.每个单位带一个「相对基准单位」的换算因子，先把数值折算到基准单位、再除以目标单位: Each unit has a factor relative to the base unit; the value is first converted to the base unit and then divided by the target unit factor to get the result. Temperature does not use a ratio factor and is instead converted pair by pair with dedicated °C/°F/K/°R formulas.
map.通用单位换算（系数表制）：结果 = 数值 × 源单位因子 ÷ 目标单位因子（长度: General unit conversion (factor-table based): result = value × source-unit factor ÷ target-unit factor (per-category tables such as length/mass: meter 1, kilometer 1000, mile 1609.344, nautical mile 1852). In the fuel-economy category, km/L, mpg(US) and mpg(UK) are reciprocal units: normalize to the L/100km base first, then invert out of it (8 L/100km = 235.215 ÷ 8 ≈ 29.4 mpg US). Temperature uses dedicated formulas — normalize to Celsius first (Fahrenheit (v−32)×5÷9, Kelvin v−273.15, Rankine (v−491.67)×5÷9, Réaumur v×1.25), then convert to the target unit. Validation: a non-numeric value clears the opposite side without raising an error. Behavior: no grading, instant two-way conversion, results formatted adaptively by precision.
